name: Frost Touch
description: Lay a chilled palm on the target's forearm so a rim of frost bites the skin and numbs the grip.

name: Rime Dust
description: Flick a pinch of frost dust from the fingertips to sting the eyes and cheek of one target.

name: Chill Veil
description: Draw a thin sheet of frost across the forearm to blunt a glancing blow.

name: Numb Grasp
description: Hold the target's wrist in a freezing grip until the fingers go slack and drop what they hold.

name: Cold Focus
description: Slow the breath until qi sits cold and even in the chest so later ice moves cost the user less.

name: Frost Step
description: Skate a thin film of ice under the lead foot to slide one pace sideways out of the line of attack.

name: Calm Rime
description: Hold a fine layer of rime on the palm to learn how steady cold feels before shaping it.

name: Hush Strike
description: Strike with a cold fist that lands without a sound while its chill sinks through the cloth.

name: Pale Ring
description: Hold a faint pale halo of cold round the body that blunts and slows approaching blows.

name: Slow Cold
description: Press cold into one limb until the muscles stiffen and its swing comes late.

name: Cool Hand
description: Lay a cold palm on an ally's bleeding cut to numb the pain and slow the flow until a healer arrives.

name: Thin Glaze
description: Glaze the ground under a charging opponent's lead foot so the stride skids and breaks.

name: Frost Needle
description: Pinch a needle of ice between two fingers and drive it into the gap at an armoured joint.

name: Rime Skin
description: Lay a fine film of rime over the whole skin and hold it still to train even control of cold.

name: Hoar Jab
description: Jab a rimed knuckle into the ribs so the frost cracks and burns through the shirt.

name: Frozen Sleeve
description: Turn a blade aside along a sleeve stiffened with ice so the edge slides off.

name: Pinch Frost
description: Pinch the cuff of an opponent and freeze it to the skin so the arm cannot swing wide.

name: Snap Bead
description: Flick a frozen bead from the thumb to crack against the target's knuckles.

name: Numb Palm
description: Press an open cold palm to the chest so the cold spreads and the breath catches.

name: Frost Palm
description: Raise a cold palm coated in thick frost to stop a thrown dart or a short punch.

name: Soft Freeze
description: Rest a cold hand on the opponent's shoulder until the arm heavies and the guard sinks.

name: Chill Draw
description: Draw the warmth out of the palm in one breath so the next cold strike lands harder.

name: Gliding Palm
description: Brush the floor with a cold palm to leave a slick track and glide along it.

name: Frost Wipe
description: Wipe a cold hand across a burn on the user or an ally to draw out the heat and ease the pain.

name: Sliver Flick
description: Snap a sliver of ice into being between the fingers and throw it at the throat of a target.

name: Twin Shards
description: Throw two shards at once from both hands to catch a target that sidesteps the first.

name: Eye Frost
description: Throw a spray of fine ice at the eyes of one target to blind them for a breath.

name: Cord Cutter
description: Throw a thin shard at a rope or bowstring or sinew and cut it clean through.

name: Shard Fan
description: Raise a tight fan of upright shards in front of the body to catch a thrown blade.

name: Crack Throw
description: Throw a shard at the ground between an opponent's feet so the floor cracks and the footing tilts.

name: Sleet Scatter
description: Scatter a handful of small shards in a short arc to sting everyone caught in front of the user.

name: Shard Return
description: Leave a shard lodged in the ground and feel through it whether a person steps near.

name: Heat Sense
description: Spread a thin chill outward and read the warm shapes that break it to find the people near.

name: Wound Chill
description: Rest a cold fingertip on an ally to feel where blood runs hot and learn where they are hurt.

name: Cold Jab
description: Jab two cold fingers into the nerve cluster under the arm to deaden it.

name: Breath Frost
description: Exhale a cloud of freezing breath into the face of a target to cloud sight and slow thought.

name: Pale Sleeve
description: Turn aside a wrist grab by freezing the cloth so the grip slips.

name: Cold Ease
description: Cool a feverish ally's brow and chest with a steady palm until the fever drops a little.

name: Hoar Coat
description: Grow a coat of hoarfrost over the forearms and chest that dulls every blow it takes.

name: Rime Knock
description: Knock a frost-covered elbow into the opponent's guard so the rime flakes into the eyes.

name: Brittle Edge
description: Touch an oncoming blade with a frost fingertip so the edge turns brittle and chips.

name: Frost Pad
description: Pad the shoulder with thick frost to take the weight of a hard hit and spread it.

name: Cold Brace
description: Stiffen the forearms with a lattice of ice to hold a stance against a heavy push.

name: Rimed Fist
description: Drive a fist wrapped in thick rime into the opponent's guard to crack the guarding arm.

name: Shed Frost
description: Shed the whole coat of hoarfrost in one burst to push back anyone in arm's reach.

name: Creeping Chill
description: Lay a hand on a target and let a slow chill spread up the arm until it will not lift.

name: Patient Rime
description: Coat the opponent's boots with rime that thickens each breath until the feet are fixed.

name: Numbing Gaze
description: Hold a cold stare fixed on an opponent while a chill dulls their hearing and balance.

name: Cold Poultice
description: Press a pad of cold qi on an ally's swollen bruise or sprain to draw down the swelling.

name: Frozen Gaze
description: Send a thin sustained chill at one target to keep them from stepping forward past a line.

name: Waiting Frost
description: Lay a film of frost over the floor and wait for it to melt where a warm step falls.
